where: landing primary action, Demo route, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed one regular-library document, click the first-screen action once, land on /?demo=1, and assert the bundled sample, persistent banner, Reset, Start for real, demo namespace, and unchanged regular library

claim: Your PDF is processed on this device with no upload, analytics, ads, tracking pixels, CDN scripts, or remote fonts.
sandbox: fresh browser context; run the sample flow while recording every request and browser storage surface; allow only the product shell, local assets, worker, and sample PDF; assert no request carries document content

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; wait for service worker control, take the context offline, and reload the demo reader

claim: Remembers your reading place on this device
sandbox: fresh normal browser context; upload the generated test PDF, move to a block, reload, and resume

claim: Use the reader with keyboard controls
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /?demo=1, operate block movement and text size with J and ] keys, and assert the visible results

claim: Export, import, or erase the local reading library.
where: Manage local data dialog, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; open a generated PDF, export its library JSON, erase it with confirmation, import the export, and assert the document is restored

claim: Only extracted text, settings, and your reading place are stored; the original PDF and its password are never retained.
where: Manage local data dialog, password dialog, privacy page
sandbox: fresh browser context; unlock the encrypted fixture, inspect the saved IndexedDB record, and assert its exact fields contain neither PDF bytes nor the entered password

claim: Scanned or image-only PDFs are reported as unsupported without cloud OCR.
sandbox: fresh browser context; open a generated blank PDF and assert the selectable-text and no-cloud-OCR error with no cross-origin request

claim: Owner restrictions on text copying are respected and never bypassed.
sandbox: fresh browser context; open the bundled copy-restricted fixture and assert extraction is refused with the owner-restriction message

claim: Adjust text size, line spacing, word spacing, line width, typeface, and four contrast treatments.
where: reader setup panel, landing how-it-works, README, catalog description
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /?demo=1, operate every reading adjustment, and assert computed type, spacing, width, and all four named treatments

claim: Places selectable PDF text in one reading column without changing or certifying the source PDF.
where: landing illustration caption, reader confidence details, terms page, catalog description
sandbox: fresh browser context; hash the bundled source PDF before and after extraction, assert the reading column contains its text, and assert the no-repair/no-certification boundary

claim: Shows an extraction confidence note and tells readers to check the source PDF when meaning matters.
where: landing how-it-works, reader confidence note, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /?demo=1, assert the visible confidence estimate and source-check instruction, then expand its extraction notes

claim: No API keys or application backend are required.
sandbox: build the product, start only its static preview server in a process with credentials removed, open /?demo=1, and assert the complete sample flow makes same-origin GET requests only

claim: The displayed artwork is original AI-generated artwork for PDF Flow Reader.
where: site footer, terms page, design notes
sandbox: verify the displayed asset, original source, prompt sidecars, matching prompt, generator record, generation date, and rendered footer credit
